definitions.ask: How should oversize provider instruction bundles get back under Codex's 32 KiB cap?
definitions.why: Keeps the documented explicit channel without betting on undocumented Codex limits

choices.label: Shrink always-inlined content until every bundle fits; the cap stays 32 KiB
Raise the cap only after a delivery test proves Codex accepts larger bundles

definitions.ask: What should happen to waiters whose root blocker has terminally failed?
definitions.why: Expiring a waiter discards user-launched work, so keep a human in the loop

choices.label: The blocker notice gets a one-key expire action; waiters stay until a human acts
Waiters expire automatically once their root blocker is terminally failed

definitions.ask: Keep an hourly "still held" +1 on undismissed Workspace-held notices?
definitions.why: Shows the hold is still live at one write per hour; dismissed rows never tick
